title: While the setting is off no line can be marked, existing ones can be unmarked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours at $120.00 an hour and line 2 of 1.5 hours with one stock part costing $40.00, line 2 marked No Charge under Goodwill while the setting was on.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open line 1's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Edit line".
  4. Open line 2's three-dots menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Line 2 keeps its chip and $0.00.

Step 2:

  • Line 1's menu offers no "Mark as No Charge".

Step 3:

  • Edit Line shows no "No Charge" checkbox.

Step 4:

  • Line 2's menu offers "Mark as Billable" and "Change category".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-N1: “If the setting is off, no line offers Mark as No Charge and Edit Line shows no checkbox; existing no-charge lines keep their chip and their $0.00 price until the work order is invoiced. A no-charge line can still be marked Billable and its category changed from the line menu while the setting is off, as S2-N1 allows for a whole work order; Mark as No Charge is not offered.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
